items.text: A “Jean Tinguely–Niki de Saint Phalle Museum” exists in Fribourg, Switzerland, entirely dedicated to her and her husbands’ works.
The Sprengel Museum has the largest holdings of Niki de Saint Phalle's work, and other major holdings are at MAMAC.
